entries.title: Public Record
entries.gap: Lots of people share the same civic complaint, but there's no easy way to turn it into a proposal someone would act on.
entries.description: A civic-action prototype that turns an issue into an evidence-backed proposal and a draft for review.
post_text: Made a small MVP for Indian taxpayers to discuss shared issues and take them forward together.
Exploring ballots, grievance automation & collective submissions.
Legal/dev folks, would love your take. Intro below, links in replies. (BuildLog 001)

entries.title: IrisFlow
entries.gap: My webcam already sees where I'm looking. Why can't my laptop act on it?
entries.description: Webcam-based gaze interaction for reading, pointer movement and deliberate gestures.
post_text: Introducing IrisFlow (Netra): your eyes lead, your Mac follows.
Look near a control. Hold Right Option. Release to place. Enter to act.
Just your webcam. Runs locally. Still alpha. (BuildLog 002)

entries.title: yt2apple
entries.gap: Moving from YouTube Music to Apple Music meant rebuilding my queue song by song.
entries.description: Capture a YouTube Music queue, review song metadata and hand it to TuneMyMusic for transfer to Apple Music.
